title: Integer/Cardinal modulo (truncated remainder, sign of dividend)
rationale: Model-drafted by local qwen3-coder:30b from measured FPC evidence: integer `mod` is the truncated remainder whose sign follows the dividend (-7 mod 2 = -1), matching Rust's integer `%`; gate-validated and oracle-proven on signed (incl. negative) and unsigned cases. Division by zero and Low(Integer) mod -1 are out of scope.
